finding: Independently audited prospective dimensionless energy residual r_E = (E_target - E_source - Delta_E_mesh_independent) / E_source (units mJ = kN*mm; r_E > 0 denotes excess hardening, r_E < 0 denotes excess relaxation); identified circular in-sample calibration if Delta_E_mesh is tuned to Package 115 (+2.0295%) to evaluate Package 113 (+2.0080%) within the same Increment 79 control family; demonstrated that mesh energy shift is strongly state-dependent on crack localization (Frame 77: +0.150%, Inc 78: +1.750%, Inc 79: +2.026%), so a constant geometric offset fails on earlier increments; classified criterion as PROSPECTIVE_CRITERION_REQUIRES_HOLDOUT_VALIDATION; strictly retained binding Gate C1-2 Step 2 failure (C1_2_STEP2_ENERGY_GATE_FAILED) with autonomous C5 remeshing blocked; and specified a rigorous out-of-sample holdout test at Increment 85.
